qAndA.answer: She has a background in social enterprise, specifically cooking food for socially isolated people, and is a qualified youth worker who has worked with young people with disabilities and young offenders.
qAndA.question: Besides her role as Deputy Leader, what other relevant experience does Cllr Akinola have?

text_to_speech: my name is councillor kemi akanola and i'm the new deputy leader of onesworth council i became involved in local politics when i was working in food poverty and i couldn't get it onto the council agenda so i thought do you know what the only way to do that is to get involved myself and make a difference i also felt that there was a lack of black female representation on the council so it's great that this new administration will be putting that right we need voices on the council that reflect the diverse population of one's worth my background is in social enterprise cooking food for people who are socially isolated and bringing them together i'm also a qualified youth worker and work with young people with disabilities and young offenders providing them with positive opportunities to gain skills under my cabinet portfolio i will be leading on the voluntary sector business engagement and culture my early priorities are to set up a voluntary sector service in the borough an anti-poverty commission to address poverty and working on ensuring one's worth is a borough sanctuary for refugees i also want to help support the boris charities and startups and i can't wait to get started you

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: My name is Councillor Kemiakanoela and I'm the new deputy leader of once
with Council. I became involved in local politics when I was working in food
poverty and I couldn't get it onto the Council agenda so I thought do you
know what the only way to do that is to get involved myself and make a
difference. I also felt that there was a lack of black female representation on
the Council so it's great that this new administration will be putting that
right. We need voices on the Council that reflect the diverse population of
once were. My background is in social enterprise cooking food for people who
are socially isolated and bringing them together. I'm also a qualified youth
worker and work with young people with disabilities and young offenders
providing them with positive opportunities to gain skills. Under my cabinet
portfolio I will be leading on the voluntary sector business engagement and
culture. My early priorities are to set up a voluntary sector service in the
borough, an anti-poverty commission to address poverty and working on ensuring
one's worth is a borough sanctuary for refugees. I also want to help support the
boroughs charities and start-ups and I can't wait to get started.
